Fixed `page` to compute the start index as `(number - 1) * size` (pages are 1‑based). | ## Test results after the fix ```text ---------------------------------------------------------------------- Ran 4 tests in 0.000s OK ``` All unit tests now pass. ### Summary The missing last page was caused by two bugs: 1. `page_count` used floor division, under‑counting when the final page wasn’t full. 2. `page` started at `number * size`, skipping the first page entirely. Both issues have been corrected in `src/pager.py`, and the test suite confirms the fix. No further work is required.
